messages:
Alex: Quick post-call notes from the ACME security review — they asked for a clear audit-log export path, RBAC mapping for service accounts, and KMS envelope rotation proof. Need owners and a short plan.
Priya: thanks Alex. I can own the RBAC mapping doc. Quick Q: they want per-tenant role ancestry (who can impersonate who) and a CSV mapping. Do we have an existing report?
Sam: we have /internal/reports/rbac-extract but it’s not per-tenant. I can add tenant_id column and strip PII. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Jorge: I’ll take log export. We need to confirm retention windows and the export format they accept (Syslog vs S3/NDJSON). I think S3 NDJSON with gzip is fine.
Alex: ACME specifically asked for SIEM-friendly JSON and an HMAC-signed manifest for integrity. Jorge — can you add a manifest sig step?
Jorge: yep. plan: 1) S3 export (daily partitioned) 2) manifest.json.gz (sha256 + KMS-signed envelope) 3) sample NDJSON with field map. Will attach sample to the ticket.
Priya: on RBAC: is impersonation limited to service accounts in Dedicated? ACME uses Dedicated with Private control plane. We should call out differences for Hosted vs Dedicated.
Sam: impersonation paths depend on platform: Hosted uses short-lived tokens via our auth gateway (no cross-tenant impersonation). Dedicated can be configured to allow org-admin impersonation; we should document default deny + opt-in.
audits-bot: Reminder: evidence request created #EV-4721 assigned to eng-security. Due in 7 days.
Alex: vuln triage note: ACME asked about a CVE we patched in runtime v2.1.0 — they want proof that the running cluster is on patched runtime and that auto-updates are disabled for their Dedicated instance. How do we show this?
Sam: we can provide: 1) cluster manifest with runtime image tag 2) agent heartbeat logs showing version 2.1.0 3) a short runbook excerpt showing auto-update is OFF for tenant. Example heartbeat line: `2025-11-02T14:12:03Z host-a runtime:redwood-runtime:v2.1.0 status:healthy`
Priya: for KMS envelope rotation proof — they want key provenance and rotation timestamps + signed key-hash chain. We support KMS envelope wrapping with either AWS KMS or HSM. We'll produce: key_metadata.csv, rotation_log.ndjson, and the exported key-envelopes proof bundle.
Jorge: FYI: for KMS-signed manifests we use our kms-sign tool. Example usage: `kms-sign --key arn:aws:kms:... --file manifest.json --out manifest.sig` — includes sig metadata. I’ll include the exact command in the ticket.
Alex: can we also include minimal IR evidence: last 90 days of access logs for the privileged role that performed the patch? ACME asked for who initiated the patch.
Sam: yes — we can export last 90 days filtered by principal=deploy-bot and action=runtime_update. I’ll redact IPs.
Priya: I’ll draft the RBAC CSV with columns: tenant_id, principal_id, principal_type, role, allowed_impersonations, notes. Will post a sample row in the ticket for review.
Jorge: tagging @Sam and @Priya — I’ll drop sample NDJSON log + manifest by EOD. Sam — can you confirm the heartbeat lines include instance IDs for traceability?
Sam: confirmed, heartbeat includes instance_id and region.
Alex: thanks everyone. I’ll update the customer facing answers doc with links to the artifacts once they’re uploaded to the EV-4721 evidence bundle. If anything slips, ping me in this thread. :thumbsup:
Priya: ack.
Sam: on it.
Jorge: uploading in a bit.
Alex: (after upload) Attached: s3://redwood-evidence/EV-4721/sample-ndjson.gz, s3://redwood-evidence/EV-4721/manifest.json.sig, s3://redwood-evidence/EV-4721/rbac-sample.csv. I added checksums and a short README in the bundle.
audits-bot: Evidence bundle EV-4721 uploaded by Jorge at 2025-11-03T18:04:45Z.
Priya: reviewed bundle — small nit: RBAC CSV uses `service_account` vs `svc_account` — I'll normalize and push update.
Sam: verified heartbeat lines inside logs. All good.
Alex: closing loop: deliverables promised to ACME — RBAC CSV, NDJSON sample + manifest sig, KMS rotation log, patch provenance, and 90d access logs. I’ll schedule a follow-up call if they request deeper forensics.
Priya: thanks.
Jorge: thanks all.
Sam: bye.
